name: First Steps
description: Every journey starts with a little step. Build yours toward the star.
hint: Bring the blue block beside the star, then add turquoise and coral. Choose Climb onto each block to climb your stairs.

name: Around the Corner
description: A straight line is only one way forward. Let your staircase turn.
hint: The tallest block belongs just in front of the star. Bend the staircase to the left around the wall.

name: One at a Time
description: A narrow doorway. Three travelers. Who should go first?
hint: Keep the doorway clear. Send tall blocks into the star’s room before completing the low end of the stairs.

name: The Parking Space
description: Sometimes the best next step is a little out of the way.
hint: Use the open side of the courtyard to park a block. Always leave room to stand behind it when you need it again.

name: Before the Staircase
description: Build a way through, before you build a way up.
hint: A coral block can help you climb the low terrace. Open the ground passage before reclaiming a temporary step.

name: The Extra Step
description: An extra little block opens a world of possibilities.
hint: Only one coral block is needed in the final stairs. Keep the spare useful—or safely out of the way.

name: Switchback Summit
description: A taller star. A winding path. One thoughtful step at a time.
hint: Work backward from the star: violet, blue, turquoise, coral. Place the tall end before closing your access routes.

name: The Passing Bay
description: Make a little room. Let another possibility pass.
hint: The wide central area is your sorting space. Move one block aside there before bringing the next through the narrow passage.

name: Across the Terrace
description: The garden itself can be part of your staircase.
hint: The fixed terrace already supplies height two. Connect a coral step on one side and blue and violet steps on the other.

name: The Star Courtyard
description: Everything you have learned. One last garden. Your brightest star.
hint: Open the passages, sort your blocks in the courtyard, and build from the tallest end. Keep one coral block out of the delivery route.
